Percentiles: Linear interpolation over sorted observations; small N does not establish tail reliability
RefreshBudgetSource: Only use measured target-monitor rate; optional explicit argument
Limitations: UIA provider polling includes observation overhead; viewport text availability is not physical presentation
Full status count is collection/provider completion, not final layout completion
RenderedEventArgs.FrameDuration is framework XAML render duration, not present-to-present display timing
Callback gaps and dispatcher queue delays are separate metrics, not FPS or GC pause duration
InputDelivered requires actual routed pointer/key callback; queue responsiveness is not proven click response
Memory snapshots without forced GC are retention observations, not leak verdicts
